text_blocks.snippet: Depression can be treated through a combination of approaches, including therapy, medication, lifestyle changes, and brain stimulation techniques. Therapy, such as cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and interpersonal therapy (IPT), helps individuals develop coping strategies and address negative thought patterns. Medication, like SSRIs and SNRIs, can help regulate brain chemistry and improve mood. Lifestyle changes, including regular exercise, a healthy diet, and maintaining a consistent sleep schedule, can also significantly impact depression symptoms. In some cases, brain stimulation therapies like transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) and electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) may be considered, particularly for treatment-resistant depression.
